outcome: Enable CyberAlchemy participants to describe, invoke, observe, and structurally replay finite or explicitly bounded composite work through typed contracts while preserving one root execution authority and keeping domain judgment, communication permission, and external-effect authorization with their proper owners.
scope: Provider-neutral product meaning for typed work composition, explicit structural routing, deterministic cursor replay, adapter boundaries, and fail-closed limits applicable to ETL, agent work, data processing, generation, validation, and human-gated workflows.
exclusions: selecting or implementing the RWO proposal or any other scheduler
granting recursive orchestration authority to nested composites
deciding business truth, approval, artifact meaning, or result quality
authorizing agent communication, tools, credentials, or external effects
owning retry, compensation, cancellation, timeout, or domain lifecycle policy
claiming exactly-once business effects or universal termination
representing unbounded streams or dynamic topology without a later accepted extension
creating a second authoritative scheduler, journal, or coordination store
